_about: Ethyl lactate (1) + Methanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.33 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethyl lactate, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethyl lactate, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).
